name: Galvan's Finest Pupil
label: Quest
description: Galvan's Finest Pupil: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you are ready to conclude your training with Galvan, you should journey to Gadgetzan.
There, you will find my finest pupil: Trenton Lighthammer. He has much to teach you in the ways of ornate mithril. Otherwise, remain here and learn!
Oh, Gadgetzan is in Tanaris, of course!

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is a great honor to meet another of the master's pupils!
